WA.title: I-5 Ship Canal Bridge: northbound work done for 2026
WA.text: WSDOT finished this year's major work on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge on Nov. 1. Crews repaired and resurfaced the deck, replaced aging expansion joints and improved drainage. The two right lanes that had been closed since July 13 are open, and the express lanes went back to their normal schedule on Nov. 2. Southbound lanes close across the bridge for months in 2027, and WSDOT expects the project to finish at the end of 2027.
WA.source: WSDOT, Revive I-5: Ship Canal Bridge preservation
